reading.zh: 先读 README 建立整体印象，再看架构总览、契约参考、能力治理设计说明与 VScript 语言规范；变更日志记录每个版本改了什么。
reading.en: Start with the README for orientation, then the architecture overview, the contract reference, the capability-governance design note and the VScript language specification; the changelog records what changed release by release.
